name: parcelflow
title: parcelflow
tagline: Cloud ELT pipeline + parcel volume forecasting — Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure Blob, SARIMA, Streamlit
description: Cloud ELT pipeline + parcel volume forecasting — Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure Blob, SARIMA, Streamlit
highlights: Built an idempotent ELT pipeline ingesting 695K synthetic shipment rows across 731 daily partitions and 15 hubs into a PostgreSQL/SQLite star-schema warehouse.
Engineered a 14-day SARIMA volume forecaster that beat a seasonal-naive baseline by ~16% MAPE (14.1% vs 16.8%) via holdout back-testing.
Added a data-quality stage that quarantined 16,081 bad rows (2.3%) with reasons instead of dropping them, plus a run log for observability.

Added an anti-hallucination confidence guard and a switchable LLM backend.
